name: tickturn
description: Time, tokens and cost of each Claude turn and the session total, and the spending of every day: a band above the prompt, a /time pane and a Markdown report. Russian or English UI by the system language.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language: auto (Russian when the system language is Russian, English otherwise), ru or en

reportPath.title: Report file
reportPath.description: Where the daily spending report (Markdown) is written; empty for ~/.claude/tickturn/costs.md. A leading ~ is the home folder.
